listen.port: REQUIRED: the in-guest loopback port the signed driver policy's witness.url names

endpoints.l1Beacon: REQUIRED: http://127.0.0.1:<own L1 beacon loopback port>
endpoints.l2Node: REQUIRED: http://127.0.0.1:<own Base node loopback RPC port>

maxWitnessBytes: REQUIRED: <= 256 MiB and >= the driver policy witness.maxBytes; from the measured witness sizes
fetchTimeoutSec: REQUIRED: from the measured fetch durations (<= 3600)
fetchMemoryMiB: REQUIRED: address-space cap for the fetcher, from the measured peak
minMemAvailableMiB: REQUIRED: guest MemAvailable floor below which no fetch starts
